functions.name: solve_biomechanical_bone_roll
functions.docstring:
Compute closed-form Blender edit bone roll angle theta_roll.

In Blender:
- EditBone.y_axis = (tail - head) / ||tail - head||
- Default zero-roll reference frame is (x0, y, z0)
- Given desired local Z axis target (pole target direction):
    theta_roll = atan2(x0 . z_desired, z0 . z_desired)

This guarantees that the bone's local Z axis points directly at the pole target,
completely eliminating candy-wrapper collapse and 180-degree pole target flips.

functions.name: calculate_spherical_camera_position
functions.docstring:
Calculate camera location and Euler rotation using spherical orbit angles.

Coordinates:
    x = C_x + d * cos(phi) * sin(theta)
    y = C_y - d * cos(phi) * cos(theta)
    z = C_z + d * sin(phi)
Rotation:
    D = C - P_cam
    rot = D.to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()

3. Olecranon (elbow) 3-loop hinge cosine gradient.
4. Patella (knee) rigid locking (>=90% on shin).
5. Finger bounding-cylinder isolation.
6. Strict weight normalization summing to 1.0 for every vertex.

functions.name: morphomesh_generate_concept
functions.docstring:
Stage 1: Generate a 2D creature concept image conditioned on anatomical priors.

Expands natural language prompts with standardized anatomical rest poses,
eliminating dynamic limb overlap and producing a clean silhouette suitable
for single-view 3D reconstruction. Supports Google Gemini & Imagen 3 (backend="gemini")
or deterministic procedural synthesis (backend="mock" or "default").

functions.name: morphomesh_create_3d_asset
functions.docstring:
Stage 2: Reconstruct a textured 3D mesh with PBR maps from a 2D concept image or prompt.

Consumes the concept image or text prompt, extracts foreground geometry via single-image 3D diffusion
or text-to-3D backends (including Meshy AI, Tripo3D, Microsoft TRELLIS, Tencent Hunyuan3D-2.1,
or local procedural generator), and generates a dense mesh accompanied by
albedo, normal, roughness, and metallic texture maps.

Supported model_backend / backend values: 'meshy', 'tripo', 'trellis', 'hunyuan', 'anycreature', 'mock'.
For direct text-to-3D generation via Meshy or Tripo, pass 'prompt' and set model_backend='meshy' or backend='meshy'. Supports '/boost' parameter in prompt for high-fidelity refined mesh synthesis.

functions.name: morphomesh_optimize_topology
functions.docstring:
Stage 3: Retopologize dense triangular mesh into clean quad-dominant topology.

Employs QuadriFlow remeshing or decimation solvers inside Blender to produce
animatable, deforming mesh structures adhering to the specified polygon budget.

functions.name: morphomesh_auto_rig
functions.docstring:
Stage 4: Construct modular creature armature and compute automatic skin deformation weights.

Identifies anatomical landmarks (pelvis, spine chain, limbs, wings, tail)
matching the creature archetype, aligns Rigify bone hierarchies, and binds
weights to geometry inside Blender. Supports backend="meshy" for cloud AI biped rigging.

functions.docstring:

Supports 340+ preset actions from Meshy Animation Library (e.g. Idle, Run, Walk,
Attack, Double Combo Attack, Spell Cast, Spartan Kick, Dance...).

Free endpoint (0 credits). Returns action IDs, descriptive names, and preview GIF URLs.
Categories: 'WalkAndRun', 'BodyMovements', 'DailyActions', 'Fighting', 'Dancing'.

functions.name: morphomesh_blender_execute
functions.docstring:
Stage 5 Utility: Execute arbitrary bpy script in Blender protected by two-tier AST analysis.

Blocks all dangerous imports (os, sys, subprocess), builtins (eval, exec, open),
and dunder introspection (__subclasses__, __globals__), ensuring absolute sandboxing.

Returns complete hierarchy tree, vertex/polygon counts, materials, armatures,

Stage 5: Render high-fidelity viewport preview using studio lighting and procedural auto-camera.

Frames the camera to the creature bounding box, sets up 3-point key/fill/rim lighting,
renders via Apple Metal-accelerated EEVEE, and returns image metadata and base64 preview.

functions.docstring: Factory creating configured FastMCP server instance.

functions.name: morphomesh_create_human_asset
functions.docstring:
Stage 1 Human Engine: Generate an anthropometrically accurate 3D female human mesh.

Synthesizes watertight, quad-dominant human body mesh (>=95% quads) based on Yu Nian An
canonical proportions (1.65m height, 7.41 head ratio, cinched waist, 0.70 WHR).
Constructs 24 standardized vertex groups, 10 articulated fingers (3 phalanges each),
feet geometry, 34 Rigify bone snapping landmarks with pre-bends, and 52 ARKit FACS shape keys.
Can also orchestrate full character master assembly when assemble_master=True.

functions.name: morphomesh_auto_rig_human
functions.docstring:
Stage 2 Human Engine: Rig digital human body mesh using Blender Rigify Human Armature.

Snaps 163 DEF deforming bones to anatomical landmark points with explicit joint pre-bends
(elbows +Y, knees -Y). Implements anti-pinch vertex skin weights across shoulders, elbows,
and patella, and applies initial marionette puppeteer staging pose.

functions.name: morphomesh_setup_human_materials
functions.docstring:
Stage 3 Human Engine: Setup photorealistic PBR materials for digital human character.

Constructs Blender Principled BSDF v2 shaders with Random Walk Subsurface Scattering
(radius [1.0, 0.22, 0.11]), dual-chamber refractive eye optics (cornea IOR 1.376, concave iris dish
with tear meniscus IOR 1.333), silky dark hair shader, and translucent white silk fabric.

functions.name: morphomesh_groom_human
functions.docstring:
Stage 4 Human Engine: Generate procedural Geometry Nodes Hair Curves grooming.

Creates 6 structural hair layers: eyebrow curves, eyelash arcs, straight blunt bangs
brow-grazing hime cut, face-framing cheek sidelocks, crown scalp parting, and cascading
back hair down to mid-thigh with anisotropic silky sheen. Optionally evaluates polygonal
quad ribbons for real-time FBX/glTF export.

functions.name: morphomesh_dress_human
functions.docstring:
Stage 5 Human Engine: Synthesize tailored wardrobe and character magic props.

Generates sleeveless white strap slip dress bodice, cinched high-waist sash with hanging
ribbon streamers, 20-pleat flared skirt with collision offset (0.015m) to eliminate clipping,
flat slip-on sandals, 10 taut glowing crimson marionette strings tethered to finger distal heads,
and 10 instanced luminous white butterflies.

functions.name: morphomesh_assemble_master_character
functions.docstring:
Stage 6 Master Assembly: Orchestrate complete digital human scene in Blender 4.5+ LTS.

Constructs 7-tier collection hierarchy (Yu_Nian_An_Master, 01_Body, 02_Hair, 03_Wardrobe,
04_Props, 05_Armature, 06_Lights_Camera), integrates 100% pure quad body mesh with 29 vertex
groups and 34 landmarks, builds Rigify 163 DEF bones armature with anti-pinch weights,
parents 6 strata hair curves with Melanin shader, fits white slip dress and sandals with
Solidify 0.002m and armature binding, tethers 10 crimson marionette strings to fingers and
10 luminous white butterflies, configures 3-point studio lighting and 85mm portrait camera,
applies Cycles Random Walk SSS and AgX color management, and saves output master .blend.

functions.name: morphomesh_export_production_character
functions.docstring:
Stage 7 Production Export: Multi-format packaging and 4K PBR texture generation.

Exports rigged production FBX (with 163 DEF bones, vertex groups, 52 ARKit FACS
shape keys, and deformers), glTF 2.0 GLB (with PBR Principled BSDF materials,
skinning, and 52 morph targets), synthesizes complete 4K PBR texture suite
(BaseColor, Normal, Roughness, Metallic, SSS, Alpha, Height), and produces engine
import documentation for Unreal Engine 5.4+, Unity 6, and Three.js.

functions.name: morphomesh_setup_inspector_camera_rig
functions.docstring:
Stage 8 Inspection: Position and configure dedicated multi-angle inspector camera.

Solves bounding box across character meshes, determines anatomical sub-region centers
(Full Body, Head/Portrait, Torso, Hands, Feet), and applies optical framing distance
derivation: d = (R / sin(alpha_min)) * (1 + margin) for canonical viewpoints
('front', 'side', 'back', 'three_quarter', 'head', 'hands', 'turntable').
Non-destructively creates or updates the camera object in Blender and aims look-at tracking.

functions.name: morphomesh_capture_viewport
functions.docstring:
Stage 8 Inspection: Ultra-fast multi-shading viewport capture.

Executes sub-200ms OpenGL viewport frame grab in interactive session or
Workbench engine fallback in headless session. Supports diagnostic shading
modes ('SOLID', 'WIREFRAME', 'MATERIAL', 'RENDERED') and coloring schemes
('RANDOM', 'MATERIAL', 'SINGLE', 'OBJECT', 'TEXTURE').
Saves PNG to disk and returns image metadata and base64 encoded PNG.

functions.name: morphomesh_critique_visual_quality
functions.docstring:
Stage 8 Closed-Loop Quality Assurance: Automated visual defect critique.

Orchestrates multi-angle inspection and runs comprehensive structural evaluations:
1. Garment / body mesh penetration and clipping via signed distance BVH trees.
2. Anthropometric anatomical proportions (head-to-body, arm span, shoulder/hip breadth).
3. Rigging and skinning deformation artifacts (volume preservation and acute dihedral creasing).
4. Hair curves and grooming collisions with geometry.
Returns a structured diagnostic report with defect classifications, severity levels,
pass/fail recommendation, and prioritized actionable remediation tasks.

functions.name: _coplanar_triangle_triangle_intersection_2d
functions.docstring:
Evaluates authentic 2D coplanar triangle-triangle intersection.
Projects 3D coplanar triangles onto the dominant 2D coordinate plane
(dropping the axis corresponding to the maximum normal component)
and evaluates:
1. 2D edge-edge intersection (9 edge pairs).
2. Point-in-triangle containment (t1 vertices in t2, and t2 vertices in t1).

functions.name: triangle_triangle_intersection_moller
functions.docstring:
Tomas Möller 3D triangle-triangle intersection algorithm.
Returns True if the two triangles intersect, False otherwise.

functions.name: get_bvh_tree
functions.docstring:
Factory creating a spatial BVH tree.
Uses Blender's native C-accelerated mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree when inside Blender,
or falls back cleanly to PurePythonBVHTree for offline CI/test environments.

functions.name: _compute_vertex_normals

functions.docstring:
Finds open boundary edges (belonging to exactly 1 polygon).
Returns mapping: edge_key (min_idx, max_idx) -> unit in-plane outward normal u_out.

functions.name: evaluate_mesh_penetration
functions.docstring:
Evaluates signed distance and face overlaps between garments and body mesh.
Detects:
1. Garment vertex penetration: s_i = (w_i - p_i) . n_i < -clearance_tolerance
2. Reverse penetration (Skin burst): Body vertices protruding outward through garment
3. Triangle-triangle surface piercing via BVHTree overlap

functions.name: evaluate_hair_grooming_intersections
functions.docstring:
Evaluates hair curve collisions with scalp, body, and garments.
Detects:
1. Submerged roots (root inside cranium: s_root < -1.0mm)
2. Detached floating roots (s_root > +4.0mm)
3. Hair shaft collision through body/neck (s_eff < -0.5mm)
4. Hair clipping through garments

functions.name: evaluate_body_proportions
functions.docstring:
Evaluates anthropometric ratios:
1. Total Height H_total
2. Head Height H_head and Head Ratio R_head = H_total / H_head
3. Arm Span W_span and Arm Span Ratio R_arm = W_span / H_total (Vitruvian target 1.00 +/- 0.05)
4. Shoulder-to-Hip Breadth Ratio

functions.name: compute_mesh_signed_volume
functions.docstring:
Computes exact volume of watertight polygonal/triangle mesh via divergence theorem.
Automatically decomposes quads (len(f) == 4) and planar n-gons into triangles via fan triangulation.

functions.name: compute_bounding_slice_volume
functions.docstring: Computes volume of local joint segment via planar cross-section integration (Shoelace).

functions.name: compute_mesh_dihedral_creases
functions.docstring:
Detects acute dihedral creases where adjacent manifold faces fold sharply (cos theta < -0.85).
cos theta < -0.85 corresponds to fold angle < 31.8 degrees.

functions.name: evaluate_rig_skinning_deformation
functions.docstring:
Evaluates joint volume conservation rho_V = V_posed / V_rest and acute dihedral creasing
for active bending joints.

functions.name: evaluate_rig_skinning_pinch

functions.name: make_procedural_cylinder

functions.name: create_penetration_fixture
functions.docstring:
Creates concentric cylinder garment over body cylinder.
Clean: Body R=0.20m, Garment R=0.22m (clearance +20mm).
Defective: Front sector displaced radially inward by -35mm -> R'=0.185m (15mm penetration).

functions.name: create_proportion_fixture
functions.docstring:
Creates humanoid proportions fixture.
clean: H=1.65m, H_head=0.2227m (ratio 7.41)
giant: H=1.65m, H_head=0.165m (ratio 10.0) -> head too small
chibi: H=1.40m, H_head=0.60m (ratio 2.33) -> head too large

functions.name: create_skinning_fixture
functions.docstring:
Creates 2-segment arm cylinder bent 90 degrees around z=0.
Clean: smooth skinning with volume preservation (rho_V = 0.935, fold > 60 deg).
Defective: severe candy-wrapper collapse at joint loop (radius collapsed 85%, rho_V = 0.709, fold < 12 deg).

functions.name: create_grooming_fixture
functions.docstring:
Creates scalp hemisphere mesh with 50 hair splines.
Clean: all 50 strand roots sit +2mm outside scalp surface.
Defective: 15 strand roots displaced -40mm submerged inside cranium.

functions.name: run_defect_detection_benchmark
functions.docstring:
Executes automated defect detection benchmark across all 4 fixtures and baselines.
Asserts >95% accuracy and 0% false positive rate.

functions.name: benchmark_defect_detection
functions.docstring:
Canonical defect detection benchmark function for Milestone 3.
Evaluates structural defect detection across 4 fixtures (9 states).
Asserts >=95% accuracy and 0% false positive rate.
Returns comprehensive benchmark metrics dictionary.

functions.name: run_visual_critique
functions.docstring:
Master visual critique entry point.
Executes full closed-loop structural QA:
1. Garment/mesh penetration and skin burst checks
2. Hair grooming root submergence and shaft collisions
3. Anthropometric proportion evaluation against target preset
4. Rig skinning deformation, candy-wrapper collapse, and dihedral creasing
5. Actionable remediation recommendation synthesis

functions.name: assign_dress_pin_weights

- Straps (Z >= 1.28m) & Sweetheart Rim (Z >= 1.185m): w = 1.0 (firm anchor)
- Mid-bodice (Z in [1.08m, 1.185m]): linear falloff 1.0 -> 0.2
- Empire waist cinch (Z in [1.02m, 1.08m]): w = 0.15
- Skirt (Z < 1.02m): w = 0.0 (100% free gravitational drape)

functions.name: assign_bodice_skin_weights
functions.docstring:
Assigns normalized Rigify 163 DEF bone skinning vertex groups to Dress_Bodice:
DEF-spine.001, DEF-spine.002, DEF-spine.003, DEF-spine.004, DEF-shoulder.L, DEF-shoulder.R.
Strictly normalizes sum of weights to 1.0 for every vertex.

functions.name: assign_skirt_skin_weights
functions.docstring:
Assigns normalized Rigify 163 DEF bone skinning vertex groups to Dress_PleatedSkirt / OrganicSkirt:
DEF-spine.001, DEF-spine, DEF-pelvis, DEF-thigh.L, DEF-thigh.L.001, DEF-thigh.R, DEF-thigh.R.001.
Strictly normalizes sum of weights to 1.0 for every vertex.

functions.name: assign_sash_skin_weights
functions.docstring:

DEF-spine.001, DEF-spine.002, DEF-spine, DEF-thigh.L, DEF-thigh.R, DEF-thigh.L.001, DEF-thigh.R.001.
Strictly normalizes sum of weights to 1.0 for every vertex.

functions.name: compute_wardrobe_skin_weights
functions.docstring:
Returns normalized skinning weights mapping {vertex_idx: {bone_name: weight}}
for any wardrobe component mesh.

functions.name: generate_dress_bodice
functions.docstring:
Generates pure-quad sleeveless slip dress bodice conforming to MakeHuman CC0
base mold with bilateral teardrop cups, natural cleavage indentation, sweetheart
scoop neckline, and 3D conforming spaghetti straps arching over shoulders with
exact >= +1.5mm clearance. Guarantees 100% zero skin penetration across all scaling parameters.

functions.name: generate_dress_waist_sash
functions.docstring:
Generates high-waist sash with a strict +2.5mm outer envelope clearance over
the dress waist (r_sash = r_bodice + 0.0045m including fabric thickness),
eliminating Z-fighting and mesh clipping. Features a 3D volumetric barrel cuff
knot, bilateral 3D hollow bow loops, and cascading flowing ribbon streamers
with authentic skirt drapery and torsional twist.

functions.name: generate_dress_organic_skirt
functions.docstring:
Generates a photorealistic organic A-line flared dress skirt with multi-harmonic
gravity drape folds (n=6,8,12), anisotropic anterior thigh flattening, undulating
scalloped hemline (amplitude ~14mm sag), duplicate seam vertices for continuous UV mapping,
and normalized Rigify 163 DEF bone skinning vertex groups.

functions.name: generate_dress_pleated_skirt
functions.docstring: Backwards-compatible wrapper routing to the organic multi-harmonic skirt generator.

functions.name: generate_organic_dress
functions.docstring:
Interface contract per PROJECT.md:
Generates one-piece organic dress with bilateral teardrop cups,
sweetheart neckline, 3D straps, multi-harmonic gravity folds, and scalloped hem.
Returns mesh components with Rigify DEF vertex groups.

functions.name: generate_waist_sash_and_bow
functions.docstring:
Interface contract per PROJECT.md:
Generates 100% conforming outer sash envelope (+2.5mm clearance)
with 3D bow knot, dual loops, and cascading ribbons.

functions.name: generate_flat_strappy_sandals
functions.docstring:
Synthesizes anatomical flat strappy sandals (Left & Right) conforming to
Yu Nian An's 5-toed articulated feet:
1. 7mm laminated leather flat sole conforming strictly to plantar profile
   (L_sole = 0.238m in [0.22m, 0.25m]).
2. +6mm medial longitudinal arch rise, lateral balance edge, and heel cup.
3. Sole outline stopping right beneath toe roots at Y = -0.138m (toes & toenails 100% exposed).
4. 4-band strap layout (Diagonal Instep, Transverse Metatarsal, Ankle Collar, Slingback Heel + uprights).
5. Zero skin penetration (>= +1.5mm signed clearance buffer everywhere, total height <= 50.0mm).
6. Normalized Rigify DEF skinning vertex groups (DEF-foot.L/R, DEF-toe.L/R).

functions.name: get_butterfly_vortex_positions
functions.docstring:
Computes dynamic flocking positions orbiting around Yu Nian An in a graceful upward vortex spiral.
Left hand 5 butterflies swirl around +X flank; Right hand 5 butterflies swirl around -X flank.
Guarantees:
  1. Minimum pairwise distance >= 150mm (well above 50mm requirement).
  2. Z in [0.88m, 1.32m] (strictly > 0.80m requirement).
  3. Distance from origin >= 0.44m (strictly > 0.10m requirement).
  4. Zero string-body mesh penetration.

functions.name: get_butterfly_flutter_positions
functions.docstring:
Returns 3D positions for luminous white swallowtail butterflies fluttering
around Yu Nian An in an ascending upward vortex spiral (Z in [0.88m, 1.32m]).

functions.name: generate_catenary_magic_strings
functions.docstring:
Generates 10 delicate crimson magic strings tethered to distal finger phalanx DEF bones.
Uses catenary/Bezier 3D curve drape and normal-aligned cross-section ribbon.
Strictly preserves verts_per_cord = 14 (6 segments per cord) for test suite compatibility.

functions.name: generate_swallowtail_quad_butterfly
functions.docstring:
Generates a procedural 3D quad butterfly mesh featuring:
1. Segmented 3D body (head, thorax, abdomen) using 4 rings of 4 vertices (12 quads).
2. Dual curved antennae projecting forward and upward (4 quads).
3. Distinct multi-quad forewings and hindwings with swallowtail spur extensions (8 quads).
Total: 24 quads (48 triangular faces), 48 vertices, 100% quads, 0 degenerate faces.

functions.name: generate_yu_nian_an_wardrobe
functions.docstring:
Generates all components of Yu Nian An's complete wardrobe suite.
Returns dictionary mapping component name to MeshGeometry.

functions.name: get_wardrobe_script
functions.docstring:
Generates a standalone Python script executable inside Blender 4.5+ LTS.
The script:
1. Synthesizes tailored white slip dress bodice, waist sash with ribbons,
   flared pleated skirt, flat sandals, marionette cords, and butterflies.
2. Populates non-empty meshes using me.from_pydata(verts, [], faces) and me.update().
3. Adds Solidify modifier (thickness 0.002m) to bodice, sash, and skirt.
4. Links all wardrobe objects to character hierarchy and parent collection.
5. Adds Armature / Surface Deform modifiers to bind wardrobe meshes to the body/armature.
6. Assigns PBR materials (Mat_Dress_WhiteSilk, Mat_Dress_WaistBelt, Mat_Sandal_Leather, etc.).
